+title: A final-answer prompt when the last child ends
+---
+## What
+In `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+Children.swift` `finishAfterChildren`, the parent's result is the text of its last delivery turn. When two children end at different times, there are two delivery turns. A real model replies to each post by itself, so the reply to the first post is lost from the result, and the model cannot know which turn is its last.
+
+- When no child is open and no post is unread, and at least one delivery turn ran, enqueue one last prompt before the last dispatch: "All agents that you started have finished. Give your full final answer." The text of that turn is the result.
+- A run that started no child is unchanged: its result is the text of its task turn.
+- This extra turn counts toward `maxTurns`, as each delivery turn does.
+- Update plan.md §8 step 8 and the DocC article `RunningAnAgent.md`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A parent with two children that end at different times gives a result that holds both child results, with a script that answers only the newest post in each delivery turn.
+- [ ] A run with no children gets no extra prompt.
+- [ ] The extra turn is counted by `maxTurns`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Change `NestedRunTests.leadJoinsBothResults` so its script answers only the newest post (not `.finalTextOfLaterPrompts`), and expect both results in the final answer.
+- [ ] Add a case for a run with no children and a `maxTurns` case.
+- [ ] Run `swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
